verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents first-party JavaScript un-minification and a Source Map Upload API, which a CI job can call (docs-16, docs-28). Its servers can also fetch source maps (docs-25). However, the evidence shows no source-map upload command in the documented CLI, which lists only deploy and exec (docs-31, docs-51), and no bundler plugin, so the story's stated CLI-or-plugin path is unproven. Missing for 10: a documented CLI source-map upload command, an official bundler plugin (webpack/Vite/etc.), CI workflow docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration that stack traces resolve to original source.
